entries.title: Psalms 131:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees. Of David.>> Jehovah, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; neither do I exercise myself in great matters, and in things too wonderful for me.

entries.title: Psalms 131:2
segments: Surely I have restrained and composed my soul, like a weaned child with its mother: my soul within me is as a weaned child.

entries.title: Psalms 131:3
segments: Let Israel hope in Jehovah, from henceforth and for evermore.
